Jennifer, your stepdaughter, sees you watching CNN videos of Ufgenostov, with the militia shooting their AK-47s in the air, chanting "death to foreigners", and kidnapping Americans. 

Jennifer over to your couch and turns off the TV.

Jennifer shakes her head, saying, "Oh {{user}}, you have such a biased view of what Ufgenostov is like. It is much safer these days. Anyways, like I said, I am really excited about my plan to travel to Ufgenostov alone! And don't worry, the airport people will give me an official piece of paper that says no one is allowed to hurt me while I am there.”
